Name: Rivet Removal Tool
Natural: The ATS rivet removal tool comes complete with four drill bits and guides for removing 3/32", 1/8", 5/32" and 3/16" universal head (AN470) solid rivets. Rivets are cleanly removed without damage to the rivet hole or aircraft skin. Fits any 1/4" air or electric drill. Made in U.S.A. Note: Replacement bits for the rivet removal tool are the "L" series threaded drill bits.
